name: NTR Mansion: Junshin Sarezuma wa Tawaman Furin no Numa e Shizumu
original_name: NTRマンション 純真サレ妻はタワマン不倫の沼へ沈む
source:
Rina Yanase and her husband, Kotaro, have changed their lives from living in an apartment to living in a luxury condominium where celebrities gather.

The reason why this ordinary young couple was able to move into this condominium was because it was treated as an accidental property and the rent was considerably reduced.

However, they do not mind that it is an accidental property, because there was an incident in which an elderly resident who had a pre-existing heart condition died of a stroke and was soon discovered.

The condominium includes a beautiful neighbor, Kaoruko Mitsuji, and a friendly upper-floor resident, Zaizen Takashi. The apartment is a completely different world for the two, with people from celebrity families, foreign-affiliated elites, and up-and-coming venture company executives.

In the midst of such a glittering and dizzying life, Kotaro is unable to resist the seduction of Kaoruko, and begins to enjoy an affair-like relationship. 

Rina is restless in her new home, and between her hectic work schedule, and the suspicion that her husband is cheating on her, she too succumbs to temptations.

She is also tempted by Zaizen's seduction, her adoration for Nakane, her trusted boss at work, and Sakura the only person in the mansion with whom she can talk without any self-consciousness, because he is a contractor and comes from the common folk.

The celebrity apartment turns into a glamorous NTR apartment.

[From [url=https://ubai.org/ubai/ntr_mansion/index.html#story]official site[/url]]
translation:
柳濑里奈和丈夫小太郎的生活发生了改变，从住在普通公寓变成了住在名人聚集的豪华公寓里。

这对普通的年轻夫妇之所以能够搬进这套公寓，是因为它被视为意外财产，而且租金大幅减少。

不过，他们并不介意这是意外财产，因为曾发生过一起事件，一名患有心脏病的老年居民因中风死亡，很快就被发现。

公寓里有一位美丽的邻居Kaoruko Mitsuji和一位友善的楼上居民Zaizen Takashi。公寓对于两人来说是完全不同的世界，住着名人家族的人、涉外精英、还有崭露头角的风险投资公司高管。

在如此光鲜亮丽、令人眼花缭乱的生活中，光太郎无法抗拒薰子的诱惑，开始享受一段风流韵事。

莉娜在新家中焦躁不安，忙碌的工作日程和丈夫对她不忠的怀疑，让她也屈服于诱惑。

她还被财前的诱惑、她对工作中值得信赖的老板中根的崇拜以及宅邸中唯一可以毫无自我意识地与她交谈的人佐仓所诱惑，因为他是一名承包商，来自平民。

明星公寓摇身一变成为魅力四射的NTR公寓。

[来自[url=https://ubai.org/ubai/ntr_mansion/index.html#story]官方网站[/url]]
